summary: Max Verstappen won the Japanese Grand Prix from pole position, 12.5s ahead of Sergio Perez, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Kevin Magnussen made the biggest climb, from P18 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag.
There were 54 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 3 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 13 points over Sergio Perez.
